lines.en: I walk the badlands' edge.

lines.zh: 红色的土被我的脚踢散。
lines.en: Red soil scatters under my feet.
Two strides carry me over a gully.
My shadow falls on the bare rock.
The two horns on my head curve forward.
I snuffle the ground as I walk.
Heat rises off the stones.
I turn my body slowly around.
My toes sink into loose sand.
The ridges on my back sway.
The wind can't shift my weight.
I pass a clump of dry grass.
My prints cut deep into the ground.
I walk along the cracked riverbed.
The gravel rattles on without pause.
I lie beside a boulder.
My little arms are nearly useless.
I pant out hot breath.
This rock's shade is cool enough.
I rest my head on the ground.
My chest rises and falls.
My tail taps the soil lightly.
There's red dust on my horns.
I turn my head toward the distance.
The scent around here is faint.
A low rumble rises in my throat.
I close my eyes slowly.
You're standing not far in front of me.
I raise my head and fix on you.
My horns are longer than your arm.
You smell faintly of sweat.
I bring my snout closer and sniff.
Neither of us has moved.
There's no other prey around here.
These badlands have room for only me.
I back off, tail sweeping sand.
That one made me roar.
There's a new gash in my hide.
Blood runs down my flank.
I shake the dust off my head.
My horns feel a little numb.

lines.zh: 我压低身子重新摆架势。
lines.en: I drop lower and reset my stance.
The pain keeps me panting.
I still want another bite.
That isn't my kind of food.
I'm only interested in things that move.

lines.zh: 你举着它站在我正前方。
lines.en: You're holding it right in front of me.
A strange smell; I'm not used to it.
That's not one mouthful for me.
I don't touch dead things on the ground.
The warmth off your hands is more obvious.
One more sniff and I'll know.
You've set the thing down.
I didn't shift at all.
You were thrown down onto the ground.
My hide is harder than stone.
That shoved me slightly off line.
I look down at you on the ground.
Between us we left a pit in the ground.
A cloud of dust went up.

lines.zh: 恶地的红土，被我一脚踢散。
lines.en: One kick scatters the red badland soil.
This badland is room for both of us.
We walk the same ridgeline.
Your horns are shorter than mine.
Hunting together makes it easier.
We needn't stand that close.

lines.zh: 两条尾巴甩着不同的方向。
lines.en: Our tails swing in different directions.

lines.zh: 这片恶地由我们两个守。
lines.en: We two will hold this badland.

lines.zh: 我沿着你的脚印跟过去。
lines.en: I'll trail along your footprints.
The scent of our kind doesn't lie.
Let's settle it like this.
I can't bite this open at all.
I'll have to carry this in my jaws.
A stone — of little use.
You dropped something in front of me.
I lower my head and sniff it.
It carries another creature's scent.
I shove it away with a foot.
This bone is still fresh.
I turn my head and fix on you.
That one movement was enough.
I lower my body and move in.
You can't outrun me on this ground.
You've backed toward the cliff.
I picked up the pace two strides.
Heat comes from my mouth.
I've locked onto that direction.
There's no road behind you.
I let out a low roar.

lines.zh: 你举起的东西挡不住我。
lines.en: What you raised won't stop me.
I'm already very close to you.
I follow the scent of you.
The rocks block my sight.
I go round the long way.
You're crouched behind that stone.

lines.zh: 我把头低到和你一样平。
lines.en: I dip my head level with you.
Your footprints are still clear.

lines.zh: 恶地的角龙，跑起来像影子。
lines.en: A badlands horned beast runs like a shadow.
I bare my teeth.
The wind is blowing my way.
Running now is too late.
I can smell the blood in you.
I gather my legs to lunge.
There's nothing here to hide behind.
My jaws close on your shoulder.
My horns ram into you.
You're knocked to the ground.
That carried my whole weight.
My teeth aren't very even.
You stopped my first strike.
My tail whips your side.
You're retreating very fast.
You scraped two furrows in the dirt.
I lower my head again.
Your armor has caved in.
I come down the badland slope.

lines.zh: 脚下的土松得一踩就散。
lines.en: The soil crumbles under each step.
I raise my head and sweep the area.

lines.zh: 这里红土广得看不到边。
lines.en: The red earth stretches out of sight.
Hot sand rides the wind.
I spread my toes for grip.

lines.zh: 我嗅到了一点活物的气味。
lines.en: I catch the scent of something alive.
My shadow shifts on the cliff.
The old scar on my horns remains.
I move slowly eastward.
There's little to eat here.
I stop and take a look first.
The heat blurs the distance.
Water floods into my nostrils.
The blast flipped me onto my side.

lines.zh: 那股力量在我的骨头里烧。
lines.en: That force burns inside my bones.
I'm starving, and my strength is fading.
Lightning struck my thick hide.

lines.zh: 下面什么也没有，恶地的虚空真空。
lines.en: Nothing below; the badlands void is empty.
